prediction_before_run: An image-only pair initializes state and design covariance; the initialization frame is consumed once.
EKF and encoder-only baseline receive identical noisy encoder readings and the identical initial state/covariance.
ID18 messages are synthetically withheld during the single phase; actual RGB detections are retained separately.
A physical mocap board blocks camera views during the blackout; no stale measurements are reused.
Prediction-only covariance trace grows across blackout, and accepted fresh observations reduce covariance at reacquisition.
EKF is expected to reduce aggregate localization error relative to encoder-only propagation; actual metrics are reported even if this expectation fails.
parameter_basis: Engineering design assumptions fixed before the run. Encoder noise follows the previously validated synthetic increment model. Model diffusion covers unresolved nominal kinematic error. Vision stds include independent and same-frame shared components, but are not empirical calibration and do not model all cross-frame biases. No added noise to images or range/bearing.
scope: One new open-loop physical trajectory with sequential sensor processing; no state feedback, LiDAR navigation, docking or real-time wall-clock guarantee.
